en.title: Advisory Services
en.imageAlt: Strategy team reviewing market expansion plans around a meeting table.
en.metaDescription: Explore LATAM China Tech advisory services for market entry, investment matchmaking, and technology transfer.
en.bodyHtml:
LATAM China Tech advisory turns cross-border ambiguity into structured decisions. We help teams validate market assumptions, identify the right local partners, and prepare the operating plan needed before capital, distribution, or public-sector conversations begin.

Investment matchmaking, technology transfer, and market-entry strategy are managed as one connected workstream so each introduction has a clear commercial reason to exist.

sections.title: Book a strategy call
sections.bodyHtml: Use the first conversation to clarify the market, timeline, and partner profile. The team will route the opportunity to the right advisor before proposing scope.

br.title: Servicos de assessoria
br.imageAlt: Equipe de estrategia analisando planos de expansao em uma mesa de reuniao.
br.metaTitle: Servicos de assessoria | LATAM China Tech
br.metaDescription: Conheca os servicos de assessoria da LATAM China Tech para entrada em mercado, matchmaking de investimento e transferencia de tecnologia.
br.bodyHtml:
A assessoria da LATAM China Tech transforma ambiguidade cross-border em decisoes estruturadas. Ajudamos equipes a validar hipoteses de mercado, identificar parceiros locais e preparar o plano operacional antes de conversas com capital, distribuicao ou governo.

Matchmaking de investimento, transferencia de tecnologia e estrategia de entrada em mercado sao tratados como uma frente conectada para que cada introducao tenha uma razao comercial clara.

sections.title: Agendar conversa estrategica
sections.bodyHtml: Use a primeira conversa para esclarecer mercado, prazo e perfil de parceiro. O time encaminha a oportunidade para o advisor adequado antes de propor escopo.

cn.title: 咨询服务
cn.imageAlt: 战略团队围绕会议桌讨论市场扩张计划。
cn.metaTitle: 咨询服务 | LATAM China Tech
cn.metaDescription: 了解 LATAM China Tech 在市场进入、投资对接和技术转移方面的咨询服务。
cn.bodyHtml:
LATAM China Tech 的咨询服务把跨境不确定性转化为结构化决策。我们帮助团队验证市场假设、识别本地伙伴，并在资本、渠道或公共部门对话之前准备执行计划。

投资对接、技术转移和市场进入策略会作为一个连贯工作流推进，确保每一次介绍都有清晰的商业理由。

sections.title: 预约战略沟通
sections.bodyHtml: 第一次沟通用于明确市场、时间线和伙伴画像。团队会先匹配合适顾问，再提出具体服务范围。
